metadata.value: ``megaman`` is a scalable manifold learning package implemented in python. It has a front-end API designed to be familiar to [scikit-learn](http://scikit-learn.org/) but harnesses the C++ Fast Library for Approximate Nearest Neighbors (FLANN) and the Sparse Symmetric Positive Definite (SSPD) solver Locally Optimal Block Precodition Gradient (LOBPCG) method to scale manifold learning algorithms to large data sets.
metadata.normalized_value: megaman is a scalable manifold learning package implemented in python with a scikit-learn-like API, using FLANN and LOBPCG to scale manifold learning to large datasets.
